real_vs_simulated.REAL: ESA Kelvins Collision Avoidance Challenge CDMs (risk prediction, encounter geometry, covariance, orbit)
real_vs_simulated.SIMULATED: RGB images, YOLO detections, tracking scenarios, manoeuvre execution, post-TCA recovery, uncertainty Monte Carlo

meta.data_licence: ESA Collision Avoidance Challenge dataset, CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.4463683

prediction.metric: L = MSE_HR / F2 (Uriot et al. 2022), predictions < -6 clipped to -6.001, lower is better

published_reference.winner_note: hand-tuned thresholds; the team reported probing the test leaderboard

prediction.protocol: development on the ESA training file only (event-level stratified 5-fold CV x 3 repeats, nested decision tuning); each completed experiment frozen, then scored once on the ESA test set

baseline.description: Latest Risk Prediction (Uriot et al. 2022): r_hat = latest risk, clipped

selected.description: Ablation: as P3 but the correction comes from a residual regressor trained on all events with latest>=-6 or final>=-6

prediction.selected_plain_language: Keep the latest ESA-reported risk (strong baseline). An ExtraTrees classifier (V2 features) may additionally raise an alert for events the baseline calls low; promoted events get the value -6.0.
prediction.selection_rule: lowest validation (nested CV) official score; a model must beat a simpler one by more than one standard deviation across CV repeats

examples: promotion rescued a missed high-risk event

best_test_score_experiment.note: not selected: its validation score was worse/unstable; reported for honesty

experiments.architecture: Ablation: as P3 but the correction comes from a residual regressor trained on all events with latest>=-6 or final>=-6
Latest Risk Prediction (Uriot et al. 2022): r_hat = latest risk, clipped
LRP classes unchanged; only the shrunk value correction
LRP guardrail + promotion of LRP negatives by the GRU probability
LRP values unchanged; classifier promotes LRP negatives
Keep LRP positives (guardrail) and move their value toward the high-risk value regressor by alpha; classifier promotes LRP negatives (Magpies-style) to a CV-chosen value
sesc-style threshold cascade (Uriot Sec. 5.3.1) with all thresholds re-tuned on training CV (no test probing)
Two-stage; regressor value blended with latest risk (lambda chosen in CV)
CV-selected classifier (et|v2) decides the class; latest risk supplies the value
Stage 1 classifier -> Stage 2 regressor trained on high-risk events only (Tulczyjew et al. 2021)
Random Forest classifier (V1 features) decides the class; latest risk supplies the value
GRU over the CDM sequence; probability head decides, regression head (residual on latest risk) supplies the value
Regression of (final - latest) risk (Uriot et al. 2022 Sec. 6.1 target), high-risk weights, own threshold (CV)
Direct regression of final log10 risk, high-risk sample weights, own threshold (CV)

perception_v1_measured.label: SIMULATED RGB images; measured in V1 and reproduced in V2 for the demo sequences
perception_v1_measured.monocular_range: exploratory only (median |error| ~35 % from apparent size); not used for safety

maneuver.label: REAL ESA encounter geometry (latest CDM >= 2 d before TCA) + SIMULATED manoeuvres
maneuver.trigger: official-test events with r_hat >= -6 from the frozen V2 model P3c_hybrid_region_residual
maneuver.safety_rule: miss >= 1 km and Pc <= 1e-6 at TCA (experimental design values; stricter than NASA CARA 1e-4)

recovery_tolerance.basis: 50 m = Sentinel-1 orbital-tube design radius; 1 mm/s keeps drift <= ~17 m/orbit

maneuver.architecture_selected: M2: 3 impulses = 1 avoidance burn + 2-burn phasing return to the nominal (phantom) state; planned with Clohessy-Wiltshire, verified with two-body+J2 integration
maneuver.k_selection_rule: shortest k with median recovery dv within 10% of the grid minimum (pre-registered)

demo_event.rule: true-positive V2 trigger needing a manoeuvre with the most input CDMs

maneuver.final_architecture: 3 main impulses (avoid, start phasing return, stop) + 4 small closed-loop trims; CW planning, two-body+J2 verification

uncertainty.label: REAL ESA geometry + MEASURED synthetic bearing error + execution/navigation error -> SIMULATED avoidance + recovery (Monte Carlo, CW truth dynamics)
assumptions: camera error affects only the avoidance burn (recovery targets our own nominal orbit, known from navigation)
lateral error = R_obs x bearing RMSE, isotropic Gaussian
burns 2 and 3 computed from the navigated state (closed loop)
'including_track_failures' uses the mean bearing RMSE over all sequences, including the one where the tracker locked on a false detection

recovery_robustness.label: SIMULATED recovery robustness (CW truth), REAL-geometry events, verified burn 1
recovery_robustness.experiment: R2 (new, motivated by the pre-registered Monte Carlo result)
recovery_robustness.final_guidance_plain: closed loop: orbit-determination navigation (1 m GNSS fixes every 10 s fitted over the previous orbit), 3 small mid-course drift corrections and one final trim one orbit after burn 3
